title: Identification | Complete Failure | All Methods Exhausted | Shell Case Created | Manual Handling |
description:
Customer cannot be identified through any method (name doesn't match, PNR not found, e-ticket not found, Aeroplan not found). System creates a shell case with whatever information was collected for tracing purposes. Validates the No Match Identification ? Manual Handling path from Miro.

Prerequisites:
Customer provides name that doesn't match any record; PNR provided doesn't exist; No e-ticket match; No Aeroplan match
